title: InstanceConfig
description: Per-deployment configuration for a BulletinMail instance. See PRD §20.

apexDomain.description: Root domain serving the instance, e.g. 'lists.example.org'.

unsubscribeAddressPrefix.description: Local-part prefix for one-click unsubscribe tokens, e.g. 'unsubscribe+'.

mailSubdomain.description: Optional DNS label to host outbound + inbound mail on. When set, system addresses (noreply, support, abuse, dmarc) and the unsubscribe mailto live at <mailSubdomain>.<apex> instead of <apex>. In single-tenant deployments this is the recommended pattern (default 'mail') — the apex serves the wiki/admin web UI, and mail lives on its own subdomain with its own SPF/DKIM/DMARC. The lone tenant's slug equals mailSubdomain in single-tenant mode, so list addresses become <group>@<mailSubdomain>.<apex>. In multi-tenant mode this only affects system addresses; list addresses still use <group>@<tenant>.<apex>.

singleTenant.description: When true, the apex domain IS the tenant (no <slug>.<apex> subdomains). The wiki, /admin/, /join/, /auth/ all serve from the apex root. The single tenant is identified by the fixed slug 'main'. First admin signup atomically creates the tenant row + admin. The marketing landing page and Astro docs are skipped. Set this in the deployments/<apex>/instance.config.json overlay for single-org deployments.
